snapshot.title: Graph view with React Flow
snapshot.description:
A flow chart of features and tasks (`@xyflow/react`) with automatic layout (e.g. dagre or elkjs).

- Nodes: features (grouping their tasks) and tasks, colored by effective status, with blocked and claimed indicators.
- Edges: dependencies from blocker to blocked, styled differently for `block_until` in review vs done.
- Live updates through WatchItems; filter by project.
